meta.title: Put a line on hold and release it

plan.title: Put a PR Line on Hold and Release It

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the test starts from open purchase requisitions.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions list, select an open line, choose Hold, enter the remark "Waiting for spec", and confirm. Verify the line shows the hold icon and cannot be purchased. Then choose Release, attempt to confirm without a remark and verify the refusal message "Please fill the remarks to continue!". Enter a release remark, confirm the release, and stop when the line is visibly open again.

steps.note: Perform the hold and release workflow and verify all requested state changes and validation behavior on screen.
Assert the final PR list remains in the Open context after release.
